title: Die Hard
synopsis: A cop, a tower, a thief in a sweater, and a vault that nobody is supposed to be able to open on Christmas Eve.

nodes.text: The limo pulls away. Argyle hums something. Holly leans on you and the radio plays a song you both already know.
You wake at the party in a sweat with shoes on. The Rolex on Hans's wrist on a man falling in slow motion.
Powell mails you Twinkies every Christmas for ten years. You keep eating them. You keep being okay.
